newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Aug 13.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Aug 13.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- U.S. envoy Ross says negotiations with Palestinians and Israelis is a step in the right direction.
- New Iranian President Khatami announces his moderate government.
- Car sales in Morocco increase by 30 percent in the first half of 1997, Japanese-made Toyota cars top the list.
- Egypt says will not buy wheat this year.
- Yemeni defence council discusses border dispute with Saudi Arabia.
- Bombay-based Jet Airways to buy out 40 percent share held equally by Kuwait Airways and Gulf Air in the Indian Tail Winds.
- Saudi interior ministry warns people against employing foreigners staying in the kingdom illegally.
